messages.中指の味方と嫉妬の完全共鳴を作り、守備の反撃「倍返し」を攻撃レベルの高い「正義の: A Blunt Identity that forms Envy Absolute Resonance with Middle allies, converting her defense counter, Multifold Retribution, into the high-Offense-Level A Just Vengeance to retaliate for heavy damage.
messages.反撃「倍返し」: 2コインの反撃(打撃、スキルレベル人格Lv+5)。Ⅰ・Ⅱコイン: **Counter — Multifold Retribution**: A 2-Coin counter (Blunt, Skill Level Identity Lv +5). On hit, Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each push her own Stagger Threshold back by 3/5. If total Envy Absolute Resonance is 6 or more at Combat Start, she uses A Just Vengeance as an Envy skill when countering, up to 2 times per turn. This change is added at Uptie Ⅳ.
messages.攻撃レベルの増加: S3「正義の仕返し」は(最も多い完全共鳴数÷2)だけ攻撃レベ: **Offense Level increase**: S3 A Just Vengeance gains Offense Level equal to (highest Absolute Resonance ÷ 2), up to 4/6. S2 Proof of Loyalty gains (highest Absolute Resonance ÷ 3/2) at Combat Start, up to 4/6. With Envy Absolute Resonance, both gain an extra 50%, and in Focused Encounters with a deployment limit of 7 or fewer, the increase is doubled. Counters count as Defense skills, so the level-difference adjustment carries straight into the counter's power.
messages.S2「義理証明」: 2コイン(マッチ威力4〜14/4〜16)のマッチ用スキル。Ⅱ: **S2 — Proof of Loyalty**: A 2-Coin Clash skill (Clash Power 4–14/4–16). Coin Ⅱ inflicts 3 Bleed and 1 Damage Down.
messages.S1「帳簿確認」: 使用時に自分の精神力を5回復し、出血を付与する。: **S1 — Checking the Book**: Restores 5 of her own SP on use and inflicts Bleed.
messages.バトルパッシブ「怨恨の刺青」(嫉妬×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分を含む味方: **Combat passive — Vengeance Tattoo (4 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Each time allies, including herself, take damage 3 times, she gains 1 Envy DMG Up next turn, up to 5. At Turn End, the enemy that dealt the most damage to allies receives Vengeance Mark, and while that enemy is her main target, she gains +1 Final Power/Coin Power.
messages.中指所属など、嫉妬を多く持つ味方で編成し、嫉妬の完全共鳴を作る。条件を満たしたタ: Build the team with allies who have many Envy skills, such as Middle members, to form Envy Absolute Resonance. On turns that meet the condition, set up Multifold Retribution and answer attacking enemies with a high-level A Just Vengeance. The counter only triggers when enemies attack her, so staggering enemies first with Resonance-building attacks can make it fizzle. Take Clashes with S2, and recover with S1 when SP is short.
